text:
Camila: Kicking off a pilot with IdentityHub to validate SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and KMS/HSM key management ahead of a marketplace listing. Goal: pilot + security review in ~4 weeks. Need a short checklist and owners. Ping @Rahul @Ben @Sofia.

Rahul: Thanks — quick flags: we need HSM attestation (FIPS/SOC2), BYOK flow documented, key rotation policy, and proof that SCIM v2 provisioning respects group -> role mappings. Also require short-lived TLS certs for metadata endpoints.

Ben: From infra side — confirm whether IdentityHub will store keys in their own HSM or allow Redwood to use customer-managed keys (BYOK). We'll need an integration service account, limited scopes, and a test tenant. Also, share the SAML metadata and SCIM schema.

IdV-Rep (IdentityHub): We support SAML 2.0 + SCIM 2.0 and CloudHSM with BYOK. We'll provide SAML metadata, SCIM mapping doc, and an ephemeral test tenant for dev. I am Priya from IdentityHub — priya@identityhub.example.

Sofia: Product ask — timeline for marketplace listing + joint announcement? We need final integration signoff 1 week before the announcement for screenshots, legal logos, and support playbook. Also want to confirm SLA/backstop for dedicated customers.

Camila: Proposal: meet Tue 10am PT to align checklist and 4-week pilot timeline. Action items I’m taking: draft joint announcement timeline, compile marketplace compliance checklist. Assign @Ben for infra runbook, @Rahul for security attestations. Priya, please drop metadata + SCIM mapping before EOD Fri if possible.

Ben: Quick sample for SAML ACS + SCIM base URL we'll use in the test tenant:
```
SAML ACS: https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs/identityhub
EntityID: https://redwood.example.com/saml/metadata
SCIM Base: https://scim.identityhub.test/api/v2/
```
Also, SCIM mapping example for groups -> roles: `group.displayName => role.name` (custom mapping).

Rahul: Add E2E tests to checklist: SAML handshake with attribute mapping, SCIM create/update/delete user flows, and a KMS key import + rotation test. Need pentest window scheduled; also require consent screen/privacy mapping doc.

IdV-Rep (IdentityHub): We'll provide test certs (short-lived) and a signed metadata blob. We can also run a dry-run of the provisioning flow with your SRE team. Priya: I'll join Tue meeting.

Luis: Solutions engineering offering — I can stand up 2 pilot customer tenants and a simple regression script to validate provisioning vs. expected RBAC. Also can capture telemetry hooks (events for provisioning, key-rotation webhooks). What telemetry fields do you need?

marketplace-bot: Checklist updated — draft listing uploaded to drive: https://drive.company.example/identityhub-marketplace-draft (owner: Camila).

Camila: Thanks everyone — next steps: Priya uploads metadata + mapping by Fri, Ben to produce infra runbook and test tenant details, Rahul to start security checklist and pentest scheduling, Luis to prep pilot tenants. I'll circulate calendar invite for Tue 10am PT and draft the announcement timeline. :thumbsup:
